The only design flaw is that, with the gas control below the handle on the right side, you cannot fully grip the handle (only with your finger tips).  You have to be careful that it doesn't slip out of your hand when you are picking it up and moving it.

Results.ReviewText: This grill exceeded expectations even though I bought it based on the trust and results have had with previous Weber purchases.  It does a great job with regard to heat range and biscuits ability to cook beautifully and thoroughly unlike the Coleman portable that came with my travel trailer. Clean up is a snap and it works well using a conversion hose and 20 pound propane tank.  It is fairly lightweight and travels well.  I would encourage you to get the version that has the thermometer in the lid.

Results.ReviewText:
Nice little grill.  We bought it for use when traveling in our motorhome. 
Some engineering/design issues tho, the handle on the right side is useless.  The location of the propane connector and regulator are in the way of where your hand would go. 
Also, the propane connector needed some tweeking to allow for the larger propane cylinder to fit, works fine now.
USER HINT:  cut the bottoms from larger Country Crock margarine containers and put the inside the Weber foil grease catcher.  They work fine and you won't have to pay Weber $3.50ea for their foil liners.

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased this grill and used it minimally over one summer (3 times) before it stopped working. 

I contacted customer service and sent them all the information needed for a replacement and I have yet to receive an email in reply nor receive a replacement. 

Furthermore, I sent them another email to check on my claim and I did not receive an email back to that either.

Highly disappointed. Webber is a great brand, as I have purchased other items, unfortunately their customer service is awful. Now I do not have a grill to use for this summer. Going forward, I will not be buying any other Webber brand items in the future. 

Extremely disappointed!

Absolutely love this grill. I was surprised how many quarter pound hamburgers it will hold. I used it the day after we got it. I have used it at least 4 times when it wasn't over 100° outside, no
